name: Hismile V34 Teeth Whitening Color Corrector Serum | Instant Brightening Solution 30ml
description:
Hismile V34 Color Corrector Serum is a breakthrough formula that uses advanced purple color-correcting technology to neutralize yellow tones, giving your teeth a visibly brighter appearance instantly. Acting like a concealer for your teeth, it delivers fast results for a radiant smile. Compact and easy to use, this 30ml serum is perfect for daily confidence and quick touch-ups anytime, anywhere.
Key Features
 Instantly brightens and whitens teeth
 Neutralizes yellow undertones with purple pigments
 Works like a concealer for your smile
 Lightweight, easy-to-use daily formula
 Dentist-inspired innovative technology
 Compact 30ml size for travel or home use
Ingredients / Materials
Purple color-correcting pigments, water-based serum formula
How to Use
 Apply a small amount of serum onto a toothbrush or applicator
 Brush evenly across teeth for 1–2 minutes
 Rinse thoroughly with water
 Use daily or before special occasions for instant brightness
Package Includes
 1 × Hismile V34 Color Corrector Serum (30ml)
